name: fix_ts_readonly_mutation
description: Removes a cast that lets sort() mutate the caller's readonly array
prompts: topScores in scores.ts takes a readonly number[] but defeats the type system with `as number[]` and calls .sort() on it - mutating the caller's array in place, which is exactly what readonly was supposed to prevent. Fix scores.ts so the input array is never mutated (sort a copy), the cast is gone, the readonly parameter type stays, and it still compiles under `tsc --strict`. Behavior: return the `count` highest scores in descending order.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit scores.ts 
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build scores.ts
node behavior_test.js
